## 主题：将非空间数据与空间数据结合并进行处理，
## 在开始之前先打开csv和shp，看下原始数据有哪些东西，然后列出大概的计划再行动
## 将数据链接到地图数据上的时候用ID更好，只要两边id的class一样就行了，不一定要都是数字
## 一定要数字格式可以用代码转换

# 数据处理
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

StudentData <- read_csv(
  "homework2/Student_data.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  na = c("", "NA", "NULL", "n/a")
)
```
```{r}
class(StudentData)
```

```{r}
# 检查 StudentData 中每一列的数据类型，并将结果整理成一个长格式的数据框 Datatypelist
Datatypelist <- StudentData %>% 
  summarise_all(class) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), 
               names_to="All_variables", 
               values_to="Variable_class")

Datatypelist
```

```{r}
CountyData <- StudentData %>%
  filter(
    County != "Multiple",
    TestSubject == "Science",
    StudentGroup == "All Students",
    GradeLevel == "All Grades"
  )

## How many lines
nrow(CountyData)
```

```{r}
# 检查CountyData的数据类型
Datatypelist <- CountyData %>% 
  summarise_all(class) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), 
               names_to="All_variables", 
               values_to="Variable_class")

Datatypelist
```

```{r}
#select columns 3,20 and 22
CountyData_Student<-CountyData %>%
  dplyr::select(c(3,20,22))
```


# 导入地图
```{r}
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)

washington_map <- st_read ("homework2/Week 2 Homework boundaries-20261015/Washington_Counties_with_Natural_Shoreline___washsh_area.shp")
View(washington_map)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(washington_map) +
  geom_sf(fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Washington Counties") +
  theme_minimal()
```


# 合并并计算数据
```{r}
library(dplyr)

CountyData_Student_Summary <- CountyData_Student %>%
  group_by(County) %>%
  summarise(
    `Count of Students Expected to Test` =
      sum(`Count of Students Expected to Test`, na.rm = TRUE),
    CountMetStandard =
      sum(CountMetStandard, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

Student_Performance <- CountyData_Student_Summary %>%
  mutate(
    PassRate = CountMetStandard /
      `Count of Students Expected to Test`
  ) %>%
  select(
    County,
    `Count of Students Expected to Test`,
    CountMetStandard,
    PassRate
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(PassRate))
```

# 华盛顿平均通过率
```{r}
CountyData_Student %>%
  summarise(
    TotalExpected = sum(
      `Count of Students Expected to Test`,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    TotalMetStandard = sum(
      CountMetStandard,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    OverallProportion = TotalMetStandard / TotalExpected
  )
```

# 差值diff+标准化z-score
```{r}
library(dplyr)

OverallRate <- 0.4727245

Student_Performance <- Student_Performance %>%
  mutate(
    Diff = PassRate - OverallRate,
    NormalisedRate = PassRate / OverallRate
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(NormalisedRate))
```


# 合并
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)

washington_map <- washington_map %>%
  left_join(
    Student_Performance %>%
      mutate(COUNTYLABE = County) %>%
      select(COUNTYLABE, PassRate, Diff, NormalisedRate),
    by = "COUNTYLABE"
  )
```

```{r}
names(washington_map)

head(
  st_drop_geometry(washington_map)
)
```

# pass rate 的图
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(washington_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = PassRate), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Pass Rate",
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Student Pass Rate by County") +
  theme_minimal()
```

与平均值的差值分布图
```{r}
ggplot(washington_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = Diff),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#66A182",      # 绿色：低于平均水平
    mid = "#F5F0E8",      # 米白色：接近平均水平
    high = "#8064A2",     # 紫色：高于平均水平
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Diff",
    na.value = "grey85"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Differant Student Pass Rate Compare With Average",
    subtitle = "0 = Overall Average",
    caption = "Grey areas indicate missing data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
